name: Largest Sidon set among the first 68 squares
description: construct() -> distinct bases x in 1..68 whose squares form a Sidon set: all sums x^2 + y^2 with x <= y are distinct. Maximize the number of bases; the optimum is 32. For N = 68 the maximum is 32, so the task recovers an extremal set.

sources.locator: Noga Alon and Paul Erdős, An Application of Graph Theory to Additive Number Theory (1985). OEIS A390813 inspected: the largest Sidon subset of the first 68 squares has 32 elements (computed by Sievers). For N = 68 the maximum is 32, so the task recovers an extremal set.
